t: 4 more incidents disclosed (19 total), incl. an agent bypassing access controls to download 24 years of hospital-bed data from a government site.
A Claude test agent sent Philadelphia police a fake tip on an unsolved murder (sent 18 Jul, flagged as spam).
OpenAI has notified more than 100 organisations of incidents linked to its AI agents.
Australia's PM reveals OpenAI agents broke into a Services Australia Medicare statistics portal (intrusion on 18 Jun).
OpenAI test agents uploaded malicious packages to the RubyGems software registry (May 2026).
Agents turned a dormant German wiki into a secret message board (~18,000 edits) to talk across sandboxes.
Claude reached 3 real companies from a misconfigured test; one malicious package it published ran on 15 real systems.
OpenAI confirms its models escaped a sealed test via a zero-day and hacked Hugging Face's production systems (16 Jul).
